## `Core/Fx/Camera/CameraShot.h`

- `struct CameraShot` — Cinematic camera shot: the field moves to 'focus' (a canvas point), zooms by 'zoom', and rotates by 'rotation' radians.
- `CameraShot`: `Float2 focus { }`

- `CameraShot`: `float rotation = 0.0f` — Radians, clockwise
- `CameraShot`: `float weight = 0.0f`
- `CameraShot`: `bool keepInArena = true` — true: the visible area stays inside the arena when zoomed in (focus is pulled inward); false: focus may move outside the arena to fully frame an object at its edge.
- `CameraShot`: `static constexpr auto Fields()`
- `struct CameraFraming` — Framing: intersects 'safeArea' (e.g. between cinematic bars) with 'viewport', inset by 'padding' from the edges; zoom stays in [minZoom, maxZoom].
- `CameraFraming`: `FloatRect viewport`
- `CameraFraming`: `FloatRect safeArea`
- `CameraFraming`: `float padding = 0.0f`

- `CameraFraming`: `float maxZoom = 1.0f`
- `[[nodiscard]] CameraShot FrameCameraShot(const FloatRect& bounds, const CameraFraming& framing)` — Shot centering 'bounds' in the safe area (weight 1); empty 'bounds' returns an inactive shot.
- `[[nodiscard]] inline CameraShot Mix(const CameraShot& from, const CameraShot& to, float t)` — Blends focus, zoom, rotation and weight between two shots by 't' (0..1).
- `[[nodiscard]] CameraView ShotCamera(const CameraShot& shot, const FloatRect& viewport, const FloatRect& arena)` — Base cinematic camera; camera effects (CameraEffects) are applied on top.

- `ScreenGlitch`: `void SetQuality(const FxQuality& quality)` — Flashes off: Trigger does nothing.
- `ScreenGlitch`: `void Trigger(float seconds, const GlitchStyle& style)` — The longer of 'seconds' and the time left wins.
- `ScreenGlitch`: `void Update(float deltaSeconds)`
- `ScreenGlitch`: `void Clear()`
- `ScreenGlitch`: `void Draw(Painter& paint, const FloatRect& area, double timeSeconds) const` — Clipped to 'area'; 'timeSeconds' picks the pattern.

## `Core/Fx/Screen/SlowMotionOverlay.h`

- `struct SlowMotionStyle` — The look of slow motion: tints the area, darkens the edges and streams slow light trails; fades after 'fadeStart' of its duration.
- `SlowMotionStyle`: `float fadeStart = 1.0f`
- `SlowMotionStyle`: `float tintAlpha = 0.0f`
- `SlowMotionStyle`: `float vignetteSize = 0.0f`
- `SlowMotionStyle`: `float vignetteAlpha = 0.0f`
- `SlowMotionStyle`: `SpeedLineStyle lines`
- `SlowMotionStyle`: `Curve fadeCurve = Curve::OutCubic`
- `[[nodiscard]] bool IsValid(const SlowMotionStyle& style)`
- `class SlowMotionOverlay` — Only the look: time itself is TimeScale's.
- `SlowMotionOverlay`: `void SetQuality(const FxQuality& quality)` — Flashes off: no tint or dark edges.
- `SlowMotionOverlay`: `void Trigger(float seconds, Color4 color, const SlowMotionStyle& style)` — Invalid times throw invalid_argument.
- `SlowMotionOverlay`: `void Update(float gameSeconds, float realSeconds)`
- `SlowMotionOverlay`: `void Clear()`
- `SlowMotionOverlay`: `void Draw(Painter& paint, const FloatRect& area, const FloatRect& viewArea) const`

## `Core/Fx/World/Shockwaves.h`

- `struct ShockwaveStyle` — Shockwave: a ring expanding to the given reach (0: area diagonal), followed by a second, thin ring after 'trailDelay'.
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `float duration = 1.0f`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `float trailDelay = 0.0f`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `float width = 0.0f`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `float trailWidth = 1.0f`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `float opacity = 1.0f`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `float trailOpacity = 1.0f`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `float rimWidth = 0.0f`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `Color4 rim { 255, 255, 255, 255 }`
- `ShockwaveStyle`: `Curve curve = Curve::OutCubic` — How the radius travels
- `[[nodiscard]] bool IsValid(const ShockwaveStyle& style)`
- `class Shockwaves`
- `Shockwaves`: `void SetQuality(const FxQuality& quality)` — Flashes off: Emit does nothing, since a wave lights the screen as it crosses.
- `Shockwaves`: `void Emit(Float2 center, Color4 color, const ShockwaveStyle& style, float reach = 0.0f)` — An invalid style or reach throws invalid_argument.
- `Shockwaves`: `void Update(float deltaSeconds)`
- `Shockwaves`: `void Clear()`
- `Shockwaves`: `void Draw(Painter& paint, const FloatRect& bounds) const` — 'bounds' gives the full reach (its diagonal) of waves emitted without one.
